name: One Reply
source:
It wasn't uncommon for Sebby to be left behind at school for the holidays due to her parents' financial situation. Sometimes, that included summer. But this year was different. After finishing her sophomore year at Riley Parks Boarding Academy, she returns home for the whole summer!

....and then catches a nasty cold.

Bored out of her mind, she knows she needs to rest up but decides to check her inbox before attempting to hit the hay. To her surprise, she receives 6 e-mails from all her friends. She plans to reply to all of them, but only has the energy to reply to one for now. Who and how should she reply?

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/one-reply-o1g-mini-fandisc]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于父母的经济状况，塞比在假期期间留在学校的情况并不少见。有时，这包括夏天。但今年有所不同。在莱利公园寄宿学院完成二年级学业后，她整个夏天都回家了！

……然后就得了重感冒。

她感到无聊得要命，知道自己需要休息一下，但决定先检查一下收件箱，然后再去睡觉。令她惊讶的是，她收到了所有朋友发来的6封电子邮件。她打算回复全部，但现在只有精力回复其中一个。她应该回复谁以及如何回复？
